title: How to Identify Your Skills
description:
In this @teal_hq class, we'll focus on helping you identify your skills. That may seem obvious, but a lot of times what we see with people who are making a career transition or looking for growth is that they don't give themselves credit for the skills they have—so we're going to dive into what that process is like and how you can identify the skills you have and the ones you may not yet possess. 

We’ll touch on: 

1. How we think about and define skills.
2. How to identify natural strengths and talents.
3. How to identify acquired skills—things you’ve learned—and how to uncover those skills. We all have latent skills that we don’t even realize are there!
4. Leveraging energizers—which are the things that we have an ability to do and that we like doing—and how to grow that list of energizers.

00:00 | Introduction
01:12 | How we think about and define skills
04:28 | How to identify natural strengths and talents
09:13 | How to identify acquired skills 
11:54 | Uncovering your skills ((We all have latent skills that we don’t even realize are there!)
17:32 | Leveraging energizers (What we have the ability to do and like doing)
24:08 | Wrapping up & conclusion


Let’s dive in. For more on how to articulate your skills, values, motivation, and interests, watch the rest of the videos in this playlist.
